sources.fullCitation: Ben Berlin und sein Orchester. “Nimm diesen Strauß Vergißmeinnicht.” Fox-trot; label credits “(Kaper – Rotter)” and “(Verlag: Roehr A.-G., Berlin)”. Grammophon, electrical recording, Polyfar “R” Orchester series, catalogue B 50959, order no. 22222, side 2, n.d. Shellac disc, Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv; filmed-label transfer on YouTube. Accessed 15 August 2026.
